limitations: Sample-level design is thin: 6 injections, two genotypes (ets-4(rrr16) vs ftn-1(syb2550); ets-4(rrr16)) with three repetitions each, mapped by the deposited Sample_info.docx; biological vs technical replicate status of the 'repetition' numbers is taken as biological replicate by assumption from the sample naming, not stated explicitly.
The RAW deposits are .d.zip archives; the data-file column lists the zip names. The inner .d folder names (listed from zip central directories) equal the zip stems.
Cold treatment (3 days at 4 C) is taken from the paper's Methods section for FTN mass-spectrometry and applied to all runs; the Sample_info.docx does not state it.
Instrument follows protocol text (timsTOF Pro), not the PRIDE field (maXis); RAW headers were not read to confirm.

Parental strain background, organism part, reduction reagent and dissociation method are not available. Propionamide is listed as a variable modification as in the search description although iodoacetamide alkylation is stated; both are reported as written.
